forum.title: 'Kudos' button broken
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @Andrew Neil,

The troubleshooting team got back confirming issue was caused due to the server error that day which is now fixed. The feature should work as expected.

Let me know if it works well on your side.

Thanks,

Lina
